capabilities: capture notes from a connected MIDI device
insert parsed notes at the editor cursor
format output as raw MIDI, scientific pitch, or ABC notation
insert a prepared ABC template into the editor
disambiguation: Not a playback or score-editing tool; it only inserts note text, leaving rendering to the ABC Music Notation plugin.
extras: Does not work on iOS because Safari lacks the Web MIDI API; Android is untested. ABC output includes only note and octave information, not duration or key signature.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record notes played on a MIDI device directly into a document, so musicians must transcribe notes by hand or use outside tools.

relations.evidence: ABC Music Notation plugin is used to render the inserted notes.

summary: MIDI capture plugin that listens to a connected MIDI device and inserts the pressed notes into the editor as raw MIDI code, scientific pitch notation, or ABC notation.
